name: read_result
description: Read current-run evidence, including a historical reference returned by read_report. Structured sections use record pagination; original_text and generic JSON pages use Unicode code-point pagination. Historical references remain historical and are reauthorized on each read.

result_id.description: Accessible evidence_id from a tool result in this run, such as feedback or video evidence. Not a report artifact_id, URL, tool_call_id or another run result; reads original evidence facts, not historical call arguments.

offset.description: Zero-based record offset for structured sections. For original_text or generic JSON text pages, Unicode code-point offset. Start at 0 and copy the returned next_offset.

limit.description: Structured sections: record count, capped at 10 (default 10). original_text and generic text: Unicode code-point count, 1-4096 (default 2048).

section.description: Feedback: summary, topics, children, originals. Historical report: summary, topics, observations. For either retained feedback reference, original_text requires topic_id and original_id. Structured lists use record offsets and may return fewer rows to bound bytes; copy next_offset. Original lists contain previews.

topic_id.description: A topic ID returned by this same feedback result. children descends the theme hierarchy; originals reads a leaf topic original page. Never use a topic from another analysis.

original_id.description: Original ID from this same leaf topic; required for original_text.
